'''Soybeans''' are an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden plant]]. They can be planted in all seasons and the seeds are edible only when [[cooking|cooked]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] soybean plants for their ''milk''.
